title: Why Science Is Switching to Bayesian Math

teenKit.tldr: Why Science Is Switching to Bayesian Math: Statistical and methodological transition from frequentist inference to Bayesian frameworks in clinical trial design and economic modeling. Investigates Markov switching regimes and transition probabi.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Tracing the primary evidence behind Why Science Is Switching to Bayesian Math connects philosophy science breakthroughs directly to how we diagnose, test, and understand the real world.
keyTakeaways: Statistical and methodological transition from frequentist inference to Bayesian frameworks in clinical trial design and economic modeling.
Lives are literally on the line.
And perhaps most importantly, a system that fundamentally aligns with how human beings intuitively make decisions.
